source_alignment.note: Page names, areas, categories, campaigns, activities, communities, and metric aliases were aligned to the current BI prototype. No BI code or UI was modified.

purpose: Conversation context, follow-up routing, contextual suggestions, entity aliases, and state rules for the free-text EyeMakkah analytics assistant.

truthfulness: Do not claim live LLM/API connectivity.
Do not invent unresolved entities or metrics.
Do not produce pricing, revenue forecasts, ROI, break-even, or financial feasibility assumptions.
Do not treat analytical signals as guarantees.

resolution_order: match high-confidence standalone intents from Parts 01–03
for short/referential text, match Part 04 follow-up intents
use prior context only when the matched follow-up requires it
ask one concise clarification if multiple referents remain plausible
never invent a missing entity, ranking, metric, or value
guardrails: Do not resolve 'it/that/this' when multiple plausible entities remain.
An explicit new entity overrides an old conversational entity.
A filter-only follow-up may reuse the previous intent only when the wording clearly indicates the same question.
Reset conversation context does not reset BI filters.
Contextual suggestions are optional UI aids and are not treated as user intent until selected.
Never turn opportunity signals into pricing, revenue, ROI, break-even, or financial feasibility conclusions.
